title: SSG IDEAS CONTEST 2024: Top Contributor Award for submitting the most ideas
image1Description: Receiving the award as an innovation driver through presenting the most business model ideas in the corporate group

section1.heading: Origin and Intent
section1.content: When the corporate group opened a space for employees to share their vision through the SSG IDEAS CONTEST project to find new business models and products, I saw it as an important opportunity to try mixing technical views with business opportunities. I intended to challenge my limits by looking for Gaps in the industry and changing them into real proposals to be a part of driving the organization toward new innovations.

section2.heading: Role and Action
section2.content: I analyzed and presented a total of 15 projects, which was the highest number in the corporate group. Each idea did not come with just a title, but I went into deep detail by making Proposals and Business Model Canvases. This was to show Customer Pain Points, ways to generate revenue, and the possibility of developing them into real products in the future.

section3.heading: Challenges
section3.content: The biggest challenge was 'maintaining quality among quantity.' Creating 15 different ideas that must have business reasons for every idea required hard observation and data collection from many departments in the organization. I had to race against time to organize the information and make the Proposals interesting and professional so the judges could see the overall possibility of each project.

section4.heading: Results and Learning
section4.content: I received a special award as the person who submitted the most work in the corporate group, which confirms my dedication and Proactive attitude toward the organization. This activity taught me to practice Strategic Thinking and have an Entrepreneurial Mindset. It made me understand that asking the right questions and presenting systematic solutions is the heart of creating sustainable growth for a business.
